messages:
sam (Growth): Idea: a 20-min micro-workshop + tiny repo that teaches local inference + includes a reproducible micro-benchmark. focus: dev adoption + captured leads.
ara (DevRel): yes. keep the repo to one Dockerfile + a `run-bench.sh`. measure p50/p95, tokens, and cost-est. include expected outputs so folks can sanity check.
jin (Content): draft structure: TL;DR, 5-min quickstart, 5-min benchmark, 10-min tips + webinar CTA. i'll write copy for GH README and short blog post.
mira (Design): will make a compact hero + 8s screencap GIF and an OG image (1200x630). also two variants for email A/B.
sam (Growth): timeline: content draft by 05/04, design by 05/08, repo + bench by 05/11, blog + announce 05/13, micro-workshop 05/19.
ara (DevRel): add UTMs: `?utm_source=microworkshop&utm_campaign=localbench`. include in README and webinar links.
jin (Content): messaging test: email subjects A) "Local inference in 10 minutes" vs B) "Ship LLM features from your laptop". small seed send.
mira (Design): will upload Figma frames to the project and attach GIFs to the GH release.
sam (Growth): inbound routing: CTA -> registration form -> GTM -> webhook to #sales-inbound. @ops-bot create webhook doc?
ops-bot: INC-5001 created: provision GTM container + slack webhook config doc. ETA 6h.
ara (DevRel): infra: need a short GPU slot to run bench canonical numbers (2xA100 for 24h). ops-bot?
ops-bot: INC-5002 created: GPU slot scheduled, ETA 12h.
jin (Content): i'll post the draft in this thread by EOD 05/04 for quick review. please keep feedback short.
mira (Design): aim for lightweight screenshots (no heavy branding) so forks look good.
sam (Growth): assign owners: content=jin, devrel=ara, design=mira, growth=sam. sync 20m on 05/06. small deliverable list in the doc. :rocket:
